description: POST and DELETE /oauth2/tokens (oauth-generate-tokens, oauth-revoke-tokens) are the OAuth app's token exchange. The spec secures them with `basicAuth` ("Encode the credentials as `Basic ` + toBase64(username + `:` + password)", the app's client id and secret), and every other route with a bearer token. The shared REST protocol sends the same headers on every call, so it would send the bearer token here and Mollie would refuse it. Remove both operations; an app runs this exchange with its OAuth client, then passes the access token as the API key.
